$comment: ownerPrefixes: a variable whose name starts with the prefix belongs to that component,
whichever bundle carries it. @nextcloud/vue is bundled into many apps, so the file a
date-picker variable is found in says nothing about who owns it. First match wins.
forceClass: name -> class, for the rare name the rules in scan.mjs classify wrongly.
Every entry needs a reason in forceClassReasons.
